summary: Focused re-test of Quality-role redaction on Job Detail Outcome tab (job recFfjigzZDl1zm6J). All 6 request items verified. Amount/final-billed Actual cell renders 'hidden', panel has no 'Dollar variance' text, Correct-a-fact field select excludes 'Final billed amount' (only Actual miles driven, Quoted crew — estimate restated, As-found note), Re-point dialog contains zero '$' characters while still rendering saved-quote rows. ui_bugs.issue: Under Quality role, corrections log entry 'final_total: — → 1800' displays the final billed amount, leaking revenue that Quality must never see per Stage-4 spec. Redact/omit rows where field == 'final_total' (or mask the value) for role=quality.

action_items: In JobOutcomePanel (and/or backend outcome payload for role=quality), redact/omit corrections-log entries where field is 'final_total' so the final billed dollar amount is not exposed to Quality role.
critical_code_review_comments: Revenue redaction is applied to the primary Actual cell and the Re-point dialog but not to the corrections history rendered inline — same rule should be applied consistently across every surface that references final_total.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks executed; 1 redaction leak found beyond the 6-item checklist

context_for_next_testing_agent: Quality role switch now works (Layout.jsx L187 fix confirmed). All originally-requested Quality redaction points pass. Only remaining gap is Corrections Log leaking 'final_total: — → 1800' to Quality. After main agent redacts final_total in corrections log for role=quality, re-open /projects/recFfjigzZDl1zm6J → Outcome tab under Quality and confirm no '1800' or 'final_total' revenue value appears in the corrections log; also verify as_found_note row still renders.
rca of the issue: JobOutcomePanel renders the corrections log using the raw list returned by the outcome payload. The role='quality' gate is applied only to the top-level Amount/final_billed cell (shown as 'hidden'), the Dollar-variance stat, the Correct-a-fact field options, and Re-point amounts — but not to the corrections history entries. Because a prior owner correction wrote final_total 1800, that row remains fully visible to Quality, leaking revenue. Fix: filter/mask corrections where field === 'final_total' when role === 'quality' (either in the panel render or in the server-side redaction that already handles data.outcome).
